dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What if it's a serious illness then?

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Do you mean diseases as terrible as Eleazar?

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: I'm afraid that in such cases, even the researchers of Sumeru City might be of little help. The only thing they can do is leave it up to fate.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: Of course, such cases would be very extreme ones.

dialogues.speaker: Maruf
dialogues.text: If anything beyond my control crops up... Then all I can do is to attempt to have them sent to the city.
